name: Coordinator decide(ask_user) in-run (run-anchor) → stamp agent.run.clarification-pending
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4b-2 PR-1 — the interactive-pause marker, anchor branch 1 of 2 (loops carrying agent.run.entity-id). When a coordinator that belongs to a run emits decide(action=ask_user), the run should PAUSE (executing→awaiting_approval) until the user replies, instead of misleadingly staying `executing` while blocked on a human. This rule is the 2-step-marker first half: it stamps agent.run.clarification-pending on the RUN entity via the subject override $entity.triple.agent.run.entity-id; rule 09 consumes the marker and transitions.

WHICH coordinators this covers: the RECOVERY coordinators (4b-1a anchor-covered) that carry ask_user in their action_allowlist and emit it WITHIN a run — research/06 (needs_clarification recovery), autoresearch/10 (baseline recovery), dev-via-test/02f (first-pass Lisa needs_clarification). These descend the loop-inherit chain so carry agent.run.entity-id (NOT lineage). The threaded recovery coordinators (autoresearch/10b, dev-via-test 02e/02f-replan/07b/07e) carry agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id and are the sibling rule 08.

RUN-LESS-CHAT GUARD (agent.run.entity-id != ""): the FRONT-DOOR coordinator answering an ambiguous first turn with ask_user has NO run minted (it never dispatched a category, so no run_scope=new fired) — there is no run to pause, and this rule is a no-op for it. The pause is for in-flight runs that need clarification, not the first turn.

ANCHOR FENCE (agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id length_eq 0): mutually exclusive with rule 08 (length_gt 0). Same corruption-to-no-op discipline as the coordinator-failed pair 05/06 (a coordinator carrying both anchors routes to 08 via the fence and is never double-stamped).

AUTONOMOUS-MODE INERTNESS (free): under agentic-tools.restricted_decide_actions=["ask_user"] the framework rejects decide(ask_user) BEFORE coordinator.decision.next-action=ask_user is stamped (decide.go), so this rule's trigger never holds in autonomous mode. 4b-2 is interactive-only by construction; no rule-level gate needed.

metadata.marker_object: $entity.instance records WHICH loop asked — forward-compatible with PR-2's resume correlation (the reply re-anchors to this run and clears the marker).
metadata.anchor_fence: agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id length_eq 0 — mutually exclusive with rule 08 (length_gt 0). Mirrors the coordinator-failed pair 05 vs 06.
metadata.run_less_chat_guard: agent.run.entity-id != "" — a front-door coordinator's ask_user has no run to pause; no-op.
metadata.autonomous_inertness: decide(ask_user) is rejected pre-stamp under restricted_decide_actions=["ask_user"], so this rule cannot fire in autonomous mode. Pinned by TestAgentRunPack_AskUserPauseAutonomousInert.
